psychological_meaning: Limed Oak evokes feelings of stability, warmth, and natural comfort. It suggests a connection to the earth and promotes a sense of grounding and reassurance. This color often reflects a mature, sophisticated, yet approachable aesthetic, hinting at timelessness and understated elegance.
